This weekend, quiet season greetings
Kudos to the whole crew
Smooth Routes for Pets

The Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways is keeping things calm, clear, and ready for travelers who fly with pets. The safety coordinator checked the usual touchpoints, and the passenger coordinator kept the steps simple for families at the counter. <<FACT F009>> Keep carriers secure, labels easy to read, and water bowls set before boarding.

On the ground and in the air, the cabin team is watching for comfort cues and helping crews stay consistent. <<FACT F016>> <<FACT F030>> Please send updates early, share any care notes plainly, and treat every handoff with the same steady care. Small details make a big difference for animal travel.
